title: One On One
description:
S2 E6 — Give Me Some Credit
Breanna gets a credit card – and Flex gets a headache.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E3 — School's a Drag
Mark gets in an accident with the school's drivers' education car and fears the tough, new principal, P.J. Moore, may discharge him. Sherman Hemsley and Don Cheadle guest star.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E4 — Limpin' Lizards
Nicole gets a part on the "Lester the Lizard and Crocodile Kids" show. When Mark complains about being assigned as the drivers' education teacher, PJ reassigns him to the home economics teacher position.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E5 — Free at Last
When Vanessa is not given the promotion she was promised, she takes Mark's advice to demand her rights and is promptly discharged from her job.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E6 — Father Fairest
When Earvin tells Mark that his greatest wish is to see his long-lost father, Mark locates Earvin's dad and invites him to the Halloween dance with nearly disastrous results.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E7 — The Goodbye Girl
Mark persuades Geneva to use "reverse psychology" on the rebellious Nicole, and they let her do anything she wants to teach her that rules are important. Vanessa pretends to like sports to impress a man.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E8 — Seoul Shake
Mark learns that Earvin is prejudiced against Koreans when Mark puts a Korean boy on the basketball team.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E9 — The Prince Of Soul
When a man claiming to be an African prince proposes to Vanessa, Mark convinces her that the man is a clever thief trying to cheat them out of their home. Don Cheadle guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E10 — Air Cooper
When an advertising executive selects Mark to star in a commercial for athletic shoes, Mark misunderstands the part he is to play.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E2 — Credit Card
Moesha has her own car, so Frank gives her a credit card for emergencies only.  When she goes out with her new boyfriend, Q,  he convinces her to let him drive her car.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E3 — Mama Said Knock You Out
Moesha has befriended a Latina student, Teresa.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E4 — Basket Case
A school fundraiser has boys putting together “date baskets” on which the girls bid.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E5 — The Whistle Blower
Mo, Kim, and Hakeem are tense and stressed out studying for the SAT’s.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E3 — Everybody Hates Homecoming
Chris is on cloud nine when a cute girl, Jenise Huckstable, invites him to the Tattaglia Homecoming Dance. However, his nerves take a turn for the worse when her father, Dr. Huxtable, wants Chris to come over to the house to meet him before the dance.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E4 — Everybody Hates the English Teacher
When Julius and Rochelle decide to raise Mr. Omar's rent, Mr. Omar demands they bring the apartment up to code and moves in with Chris' family until the repairs are done.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E5 — Everybody Hates My Man
Chris realizes that by helping the school's star running back and his friends with homework he is allowed to hang out with the cool kids. Greg tries to make him see that it's a bad idea.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E6 — Everybody Hates Doc's
When Doc's obnoxious new girlfriend, Stacy, makes Chris' life a living hell, Chris decides it's about time he split up the happy couple. Meanwhile, Tonya starts wearing a bra to get the attention of the boys in her class.

title: Half & Half
description:
S1 E4 — The Big Pimpin' Episode
Dee Dee helps Mona save her job when she comes to the rescue by hitting it off with a temperamental recording artist.

title: Half & Half
description:
S1 E5 — The Big Dose Of Reality Episode
In an attempt to gain Mona’s respect, Dee Dee gets a waitressing job to prove that she can be independent.

title: Half & Half
description:
S1 E6 — The Big Award Episode
Dee Dee invites Mona to a big awards ceremony honoring their father in an effort to have everyone together as one big happy family, but Dee Dee’s good intentions once again leave Mona out in the cold.

title: Half & Half
description:
S1 E7 — The Big Sistah Sans Soul Episode
After Mona is dumped by a guy who accuses her of not being black enough, Mona tries to find her inner Sistah until Dee Dee helps her realize that she should be happy with who she is.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E13 — Coach
Mark becomes the new head coach of the undefeated basketball team after Coach Corley quits. He starts to think that he doesn't have what it takes to be a winning coach when the team loses their very first game under his coaching.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E14 — One is the Loneliest Number
After Mark and Denise's break-up, Mark discovers that he really does love her and jumps through hoops to get her back. Nicole and Tyler work together selling candy bars in an effort to win the prize for the most sold, a CD player.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E15 — True Lies
In order to be with his girlfriend, Mark lies to Nicole. Mark allows Nicole to punish him after she realizes that he lied. But soon he is tempted to lie to her again.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E16 — The Ringer
As the new coach of Nicole's floundering all-girl baseball team, Mark conspires to dress Tyler up as a girl to help the team. Baseball greats FRANK ROBINSON (himself) and ALBERT BELLE (himself) also came to help.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E17 — Down in the Dumps
Mark and Vanessa think that they won the lottery but can't find their winning ticket.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E18 — Hero
Mark becomes a local hero but an awards ceremony reveals the truth. ELIHU HARRIS, the mayor of Oakland, guest stars as himself in his acting debut. DICK CLARK also appears as himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E19 — Here Comes the Groom
Mark's good advice to Earvin about romance somehow causes Earvin to elope with his new girlfriend, and Earvin's mother wants Mark to stop the couple.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E20 — The Matchmaker
Geneva's crazy Aunt Eunetta (also played by SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN) comes to visit and decides that roommates Mark and Vanessa would be the perfect couple. Nicole is upset when Tyler and his friend won't let her play in their boys-only clubhouse.

title: The Parkers
description:
S5 E13 — Can Two Wrongs Make a Right?
A drunken party could cost Nikki a scholarship.

title: The Parkers
description:
S5 E14 — She's Positive
T’s new girlfriend hides a devastating secret.

title: The Parkers
description:
S5 E15 — Judge Not a Book..
Nikki writes a hot book about the Professor.
